project.name: Nuxt Input Dialog
project.tagline: Promise-based typed input dialogs for Nuxt applications.
project.summary: A reusable Nuxt 3/4 dialog module for prompting users for text, passwords, email, numbers, textarea, selects and autocomplete values with validation, keyboard navigation and automatic RTL support.

caseStudy.problem: Applications repeatedly need small input workflows, but ad-hoc dialogs create duplicated validation, focus, cancellation and accessibility logic.
caseStudy.solution: Provide a typed, promise-based dialog API that turns common prompts and multi-field forms into awaitable operations while keeping rendering and focus management centralized.

challenges.title: Imperative workflow on reactive UI
challenges.description: Callers want to await a value while Vue renders a reactive dialog.
challenges.resolution: Bridge the UI lifecycle with promise resolution and centrally managed dialog state.

challenges.title: Reliable keyboard/focus behavior
challenges.description: Dialogs should feel native and not lose user context.
challenges.resolution: Focus the first field, support Enter/Escape, trap interaction and restore prior focus on close.

results: Shared dialog behavior across Nuxt apps
Cleaner call sites through awaitable APIs

architecture.summary: Consumer code calls an auto-imported composable; shared dialog state drives a container which renders fields, validates input and resolves the original promise.

recruiter.headline: Typed, promise-driven UX infrastructure for reusable Nuxt forms and prompts.
talkingPoints: Turns dialog interactions into clean async workflows
Handles focus, keyboard, validation and RTL centrally
Designed for reuse across multiple applications
